newsitem.title: UK: Grand Met shares hit five-year high.
newsitem.headline: Grand Met shares hit five-year high.

text.p: Shares in Grand Metropolitan Plc rose to a five-year high on Monday, still benefitting from recent positive analyst comment and talk of an improving chart outlook for the stock, dealers and analysts said.
"Sentiment has been relatively positive and it is realy just follow-through from that," said one analyst, who asked not to be named.

Shares in the Smirnov vodka to Burger King group were up 8-1/2p at 508-1/2 by 1453 GMT in volume of just over two million shares, after earlier rising as high as 509-1/2p -- their highest since June 1992.
At today's high the stock was some 19 percent above its lowest close of the year of 429p set on January 15.

Last week Merrill Lynch repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock, noting a longer-term chart objective of 650p, while other brokerages including SBC Warburg and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson recently said they favoured Grand Met over Allied Domecq Plc.
Grand Met reports first-half results on May 15.
